## Summary / Resumen

What changed and why? Note user-visible behavior, migrations and affected platforms.

## Validation / Validación

List commands, commit and results. Distinguish static, fixture, native, package and live-account checks; list what was not tested.

## Security, privacy and rollback

- [ ] Diff and new history reviewed; no credentials, account data, raw logs or private evidence.
- [ ] Workflow permissions and any artifact side effects reviewed.
- [ ] Rollback and security implications documented; no release approval implied.
